title: The tricky plan to pull CO2 out of the air
speaker: Vox
zh: 【Vox】從空氣中提取二氧化碳的棘手計劃（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Do you think this video will be on the Internet in 2070?
cues.en: Do you think this video will be on the Internet in 2070?
cues.zh: 你認為2070年這段影片會出現在網路上嗎？

cues.text: Maybe in some... Internet archive somewhere?
cues.en: Maybe in some... Internet archive somewhere?
cues.zh: 也許在某個......網際網路檔案館的某個地方？

cues.text: Well, researchers of the future if you were wondering what we were doing here in the 2020s about climate change
cues.en: Well, researchers of the future if you were wondering what we were doing here in the 2020s about climate change
cues.zh: 好吧，未來的研究人員，如果你想知道 2020 年代我們在氣候變遷方面做了什麼

cues.text: the answer is we were committing to net zero.
cues.en: the answer is we were committing to net zero.
cues.zh: 答案是我們致力於實現淨零排放。

cues.text: In the past few years more than 70 countries, one after the next...
cues.en: In the past few years more than 70 countries, one after the next...
cues.zh: 在過去的幾年裡，70多個國家，一個接一個...

cues.text: have made a pledge to reach net zero emissions.
cues.en: have made a pledge to reach net zero emissions.
cues.zh: 已承諾實現淨零排放。

cues.text: That includes places that have barely contributed to climate warming...
cues.en: That includes places that have barely contributed to climate warming...
cues.zh: 這包括那些幾乎沒有導致氣候變暖的地方...

cues.text: and it includes all of the countries that have been most responsible for emissions so far.
cues.en: and it includes all of the countries that have been most responsible for emissions so far.
cues.zh: 其中包括迄今為止對排放負有最大責任的所有國家。

cues.text: It seems like everyone got the message that humankind needs to become carbon neutral
cues.en: It seems like everyone got the message that humankind needs to become carbon neutral
cues.zh: 似乎每個人都明白人類需要實現碳中和

cues.text: and we need to do it in the next 3 to 5 decades.
cues.en: and we need to do it in the next 3 to 5 decades.
cues.zh: 我們需要在未來三到五年內做到這一點。

cues.text: But that would have been easier if we had started cutting emissions 20 years ago because now we're up here
cues.en: But that would have been easier if we had started cutting emissions 20 years ago because now we're up here
cues.zh: 但如果我們 20 年前就開始減少排放，事情會更容易，因為現在我們已經達到了這個水平

cues.text: and the math is getting really tough.
cues.en: and the math is getting really tough.
cues.zh: 數學變得非常困難。

cues.text: So to make it work governments are penciling in "negative emissions." That's the net part of the net zero promise.
cues.en: So to make it work governments are penciling in "negative emissions." That's the net part of the net zero promise.
cues.zh: 因此，為了使其發揮作用，各國政府正在考慮「負排放」。這是淨零承諾的淨部分。

cues.text: The idea that we can reach zero while still emitting greenhouse gases if we're also taking CO2 out of the air.
cues.en: The idea that we can reach zero while still emitting greenhouse gases if we're also taking CO2 out of the air.
cues.zh: 如果我們也從空氣中去除二氧化碳，我們就可以在實現零排放的同時仍然排放溫室氣體。

cues.text: It's a bit contentious but we're going to be hearing a lot about it.
cues.en: It's a bit contentious but we're going to be hearing a lot about it.
cues.zh: 這有點有爭議，但我們會聽到很多關於它的訊息。

cues.text: It's called CDR.
cues.en: It's called CDR.
cues.zh: 這就是所謂的CDR。

cues.text: So carbon dioxide removal.
cues.en: So carbon dioxide removal.
cues.zh: 從而去除二氧化碳。

cues.text: What we want to do is put that carbon back where it belongs.
cues.en: What we want to do is put that carbon back where it belongs.
cues.zh: 我們想要做的就是將碳放回它所屬的地方。

cues.text: Giana Amador is a CDR advocate and she's going to help us explain this with the bathtub metaphor.
cues.en: Giana Amador is a CDR advocate and she's going to help us explain this with the bathtub metaphor.
cues.zh: Giana Amador 是 CDR 的倡導者，她將用浴缸的比喻來幫助我們解釋這一點。

cues.text: The bathtub in this situation is our atmosphere and the water in the bathtub is the CO2
cues.en: The bathtub in this situation is our atmosphere and the water in the bathtub is the CO2
cues.zh: 在這種情況下，浴缸就是我們的大氣，浴缸裡的水就是二氧化碳

cues.text: that's in our atmosphere.
cues.en: that's in our atmosphere.
cues.zh: 這就是我們的氣氛。

cues.text: Before the Industrial Revolution the land and ocean typically released as much CO2 into the air
cues.en: Before the Industrial Revolution the land and ocean typically released as much CO2 into the air
cues.zh: 在工業革命之前，陸地和海洋通常會向空氣中釋放同樣多的二氧化碳

cues.text: as they absorbed back down through this drain.
cues.en: as they absorbed back down through this drain.
cues.zh: 當它們透過這個排水溝吸收回來時。

cues.text: But when people started digging up coal and oil to power their machines, first in Europe and then in the US
cues.en: But when people started digging up coal and oil to power their machines, first in Europe and then in the US
cues.zh: 但當人們開始開採煤炭和石油來為他們的機器提供動力時，首先在歐洲，然後在美國

cues.text: it sent this new flow of CO2 into the air one that the plants and oceans couldn't keep up with.
cues.en: it sent this new flow of CO2 into the air one that the plants and oceans couldn't keep up with.
cues.zh: 它將新的二氧化碳流排放到空氣中，植物和海洋無法跟上。

cues.text: About 45% of those emissions stay in the atmosphere trapping heat and setting us up
cues.en: About 45% of those emissions stay in the atmosphere trapping heat and setting us up
cues.zh: 其中約 45% 的排放物留在大氣中，捕獲熱量並為我們提供環境

cues.text: for an escalating array of climate disasters.
cues.en: for an escalating array of climate disasters.
cues.zh: 應對一系列不斷升級的氣候災害。

cues.text: So in 2015, all of the countries send someone off to Paris
cues.en: So in 2015, all of the countries send someone off to Paris
cues.zh: 所以2015年所有國家都派人去巴黎

cues.text: to say, “Okay, everyone, we need to keep warming well below two degrees Celsius.”
cues.en: to say, “Okay, everyone, we need to keep warming well below two degrees Celsius.”
cues.zh: 說：“好吧，大家，我們需要將氣溫控制在遠低於攝氏兩度。”

cues.text: And really we're aiming for 1.5 degrees.
cues.en: And really we're aiming for 1.5 degrees.
cues.zh: 事實上，我們的目標是 1.5 度。

cues.text: That's above pre-industrial levels.
cues.en: That's above pre-industrial levels.
cues.zh: 這高於工業化前的水平。

cues.text: And the exact numbers matter less than the fact that every increment of warming increases risk.
cues.en: And the exact numbers matter less than the fact that every increment of warming increases risk.
cues.zh: 確切的數字並不重要，重要的是每一次變暖都會增加風險這一事實。

cues.text: So first and foremost, we need to turn off the tap.
cues.en: So first and foremost, we need to turn off the tap.
cues.zh: 因此，首先，我們需要關閉水龍頭。

cues.text: Everything else is futile if we don't stop the root of the problem today.
cues.en: Everything else is futile if we don't stop the root of the problem today.
cues.zh: 如果我們今天不解決問題的根源，其他一切都是徒勞的。

cues.text: Turn off that tap.
cues.en: Turn off that tap.
cues.zh: 關掉那個水龍頭。

cues.text: Stop emitting CO2.
cues.en: Stop emitting CO2.
cues.zh: 停止排放二氧化碳。

cues.text: Not only have we not turned off any taps.
cues.en: Not only have we not turned off any taps.
cues.zh: 我們不僅沒有關閉任何水龍頭。

cues.text: Global emissions are still rising, especially in Asia...
cues.en: Global emissions are still rising, especially in Asia...
cues.zh: 全球排放量仍在上升，尤其是在亞洲...

cues.text: where, you know, 60% of human beings live many of whom are just emerging out of poverty.
cues.en: where, you know, 60% of human beings live many of whom are just emerging out of poverty.
cues.zh: 你知道，60%的人口生活在那裡，其中許多人只是擺脫貧困。

cues.text: So now we're here at nearly 1.2 degrees of warming.
cues.en: So now we're here at nearly 1.2 degrees of warming.
cues.zh: 所以現在我們的氣溫已經升高了將近 1.2 度。

cues.text: Frankly, we have not done what it would take to meet that 1.5 degree goal.
cues.en: Frankly, we have not done what it would take to meet that 1.5 degree goal.
cues.zh: 坦白說，我們還沒有採取措施來實現 1.5 度的目標。

cues.text: But we may be able to keep warming under two degrees if all of those net zero promises
cues.en: But we may be able to keep warming under two degrees if all of those net zero promises
cues.zh: 但如果所有這些淨零承諾，我們也許能夠將氣溫升高控制在兩度以下

cues.text: become real net zero policies.
cues.en: become real net zero policies.
cues.zh: 成為真正的淨零政策。

cues.text: And that's where things get a little tricky.
cues.en: And that's where things get a little tricky.
cues.zh: 這就是事情變得有點棘手的地方。

cues.text: Turning these emissions all the way off could get really hard really expensive or even unfair.
cues.en: Turning these emissions all the way off could get really hard really expensive or even unfair.
cues.zh: 完全關閉這些排放可能會變得非常困難、昂貴，甚至不公平。

cues.text: So everyone's kind of hoping that we can work from the bottom of the tub to... kind of increase the size of the drain
cues.en: So everyone's kind of hoping that we can work from the bottom of the tub to... kind of increase the size of the drain
cues.zh: 所以每個人都希望我們可以從浴缸底部開始工作......增加排水管的尺寸

cues.text: increase the speed at which we can drain that water from the bathtub.
cues.en: increase the speed at which we can drain that water from the bathtub.
cues.zh: 提高我們從浴缸排出水的速度。

cues.text: Now, CDR is distinct from CCS which prevents emissions at the source. That works on the faucet.
cues.en: Now, CDR is distinct from CCS which prevents emissions at the source. That works on the faucet.
cues.zh: 現在，CDR 與 CCS 不同，後者從源頭防止排放。這在水龍頭上有效。

cues.text: CDR grabs CO2 from the air and people have come up with a lot of interesting ways of doing that.
cues.en: CDR grabs CO2 from the air and people have come up with a lot of interesting ways of doing that.
cues.zh: CDR 從空氣中捕獲二氧化碳，人們想出了很多有趣的方法來做到這一點。

cues.text: The most common one so far is planting and protecting forests.
cues.en: The most common one so far is planting and protecting forests.
cues.zh: 迄今為止最常見的是植樹造林和保護森林。

cues.text: It's one of the more affordable CDR approaches right now and it has a lot of benefits aside from capturing CO2.
cues.en: It's one of the more affordable CDR approaches right now and it has a lot of benefits aside from capturing CO2.
cues.zh: 它是目前更實惠的 CDR 方法之一，除了捕獲二氧化碳之外，它還有很多好處。

cues.text: But we've seen from problems with the carbon offsets market that it can be hard to verify.
cues.en: But we've seen from problems with the carbon offsets market that it can be hard to verify.
cues.zh: 但我們從碳補償市場的問題中看到，它可能很難驗證。

cues.text: And, you know, trees don't live forever.
cues.en: And, you know, trees don't live forever.
cues.zh: 而且，你知道，樹木不會永遠活著。

cues.text: So most of the modeling scenarios that limit warming assume we’ll also be able to build a new drain
cues.en: So most of the modeling scenarios that limit warming assume we’ll also be able to build a new drain
cues.zh: 因此，大多數限制變暖的建模場景都假設我們也能夠建造一個新的排水溝

cues.text: for more permanent carbon storage.
cues.en: for more permanent carbon storage.
cues.zh: 以獲得更永久的碳儲存。

cues.text: So through things like rock weathering, we can crush up a bunch of rocks
cues.en: So through things like rock weathering, we can crush up a bunch of rocks
cues.zh: 所以透過岩石風化之類的事情，我們可以粉碎一堆岩石

cues.text: that naturally react with CO2 and try to speed up that reaction.
cues.en: that naturally react with CO2 and try to speed up that reaction.
cues.zh: 自然地與二氧化碳發生反應並試圖加速該反應。

cues.text: Or we can use chemistry to mimic...
cues.en: Or we can use chemistry to mimic...
cues.zh: 或者我們可以用化學來模仿...

cues.text: natural processes through technologies like direct air capture which basically use a type of chemical that selectively binds
cues.en: natural processes through technologies like direct air capture which basically use a type of chemical that selectively binds
cues.zh: 透過直接空氣捕獲等技術進行自然過程，這些技術基本上使用一種選擇性結合的化學物質

cues.text: with CO2 to capture it from the air.
cues.en: with CO2 to capture it from the air.
cues.zh: 與二氧化碳一起從空氣中捕獲它。

cues.text: These techniques all come with different costs and they're in really early stages of development.
cues.en: These techniques all come with different costs and they're in really early stages of development.
cues.zh: 這些技術都有不同的成本，而且還處於開發的早期階段。

cues.text: So there's a concern that the people in charge of the faucets will see any movement down here as an excuse
cues.en: So there's a concern that the people in charge of the faucets will see any movement down here as an excuse
cues.zh: 因此有人擔心負責水龍頭的人會以這裡的任何動靜為藉口

cues.text: to avoid making cuts up there.
cues.en: to avoid making cuts up there.
cues.zh: 以避免在那裡進行切割。

cues.text: Should we be counting on large amounts of carbon removal for our climate plans?
cues.en: Should we be counting on large amounts of carbon removal for our climate plans?
cues.zh: 我們的氣候計畫是否應該指望大量碳去除？

cues.text: Well, it seems we already are.
cues.en: Well, it seems we already are.
cues.zh: 嗯，看來我們已經是了。

cues.text: The US government's net zero plan calls for 500 million metric tons of CO2 removal
cues.en: The US government's net zero plan calls for 500 million metric tons of CO2 removal
cues.zh: 美國政府的淨零計劃要求減排5億噸二氧化碳

cues.text: by 2050, up from zero today.
cues.en: by 2050, up from zero today.
cues.zh: 到 2050 年，這個數字將從現在的零上升。

cues.text: Model simulations that limit warming to 1.5 degrees envision around 3.8 billion tons of permanent
cues.en: Model simulations that limit warming to 1.5 degrees envision around 3.8 billion tons of permanent
cues.zh: 將升溫限制在 1.5 度的模型模擬預計約 38 億噸永久變暖

cues.text: carbon removal globally every year.
cues.en: carbon removal globally every year.
cues.zh: 每年全球碳排放量。

cues.text: And this...
cues.en: And this...
cues.zh: 還有這個...

cues.text: is the total amount of permanent carbon removal that has happened so far.
cues.en: is the total amount of permanent carbon removal that has happened so far.
cues.zh: 是迄今為止發生的永久碳去除總量。

cues.text: So would you call that wishful thinking?
cues.en: So would you call that wishful thinking?
cues.zh: 那麼你會稱之為一廂情願嗎？

cues.text: Or is it foresight about how much can happen in 30 years
cues.en: Or is it foresight about how much can happen in 30 years
cues.zh: 還是30年後會發生多少事情的預見

cues.text: if we start our way up the learning curve now?
cues.en: if we start our way up the learning curve now?
cues.zh: 如果我們現在開始學習曲線呢？

cues.text: We have actually a really strong playbook of developing technologies and driving down costs.
cues.en: We have actually a really strong playbook of developing technologies and driving down costs.
cues.zh: 實際上，我們在開發技術和降低成本方面擁有非常強大的劇本。

cues.text: If we go all the way back to the 1970s we see technologies like solar PV be around $70 per watt.
cues.en: If we go all the way back to the 1970s we see technologies like solar PV be around $70 per watt.
cues.zh: 如果我們追溯到 20 世紀 70 年代，我們會看到太陽能光電等技術的價格約為每瓦 70 美元。

cues.text: Fast forward to 2023.
cues.en: Fast forward to 2023.
cues.zh: 快進到 2023 年。

cues.text: We see those prices down at around $0.07 per watt
cues.en: We see those prices down at around $0.07 per watt
cues.zh: 我們看到這些價格下降到每瓦 0.07 美元左右

cues.text: or even lower and at price parity with fossil fuels.
cues.en: or even lower and at price parity with fossil fuels.
cues.zh: 甚至更低，且與化石燃料價格持平。

cues.text: The challenge with that is that renewable energy produces something that's quite useful, which is energy and CDR...
cues.en: The challenge with that is that renewable energy produces something that's quite useful, which is energy and CDR...
cues.zh: 面臨的挑戰是再生能源產生非常有用的東西，那就是能源和 CDR…

cues.text: What is the customer for CDR?
cues.en: What is the customer for CDR?
cues.zh: What is the customer for CDR?

cues.text: Where does the demand come from?
cues.en: Where does the demand come from?
cues.zh: Where does the demand come from?

cues.text: You've seen some major companies including Stripe, Meta, Alphabet, McKinsey, Microsoft...
cues.en: You've seen some major companies including Stripe, Meta, Alphabet, McKinsey, Microsoft...
cues.zh: 你看過一些大公司，包括 Stripe、Meta、Alphabet、麥肯錫、微軟…

cues.text: All of these companies have made commitments to purchase carbon dioxide removal as part of their
cues.en: All of these companies have made commitments to purchase carbon dioxide removal as part of their
cues.zh: 所有這些公司都承諾購買二氧化碳去除裝置，作為其策略的一部分。

cues.text: corporate social responsibility plans.
cues.en: corporate social responsibility plans.
cues.zh: 企業社會責任計畫。

cues.text: That being said, I think in the long term carbon removal could be provided as a public service
cues.en: That being said, I think in the long term carbon removal could be provided as a public service
cues.zh: 話雖如此，我認為從長遠來看，碳清除可以作為公共服務提供

cues.text: in the ways that we manage some of our other pollution.
cues.en: in the ways that we manage some of our other pollution.
cues.zh: 我們管理其他一些汙染的方式。

cues.text: We pay for someone to come around to collect our trash and to manage it in a way that it's safe for our communities.
cues.en: We pay for someone to come around to collect our trash and to manage it in a way that it's safe for our communities.
cues.zh: 我們花錢請人來收集我們的垃圾，並以對我們社群安全的方式進行管理。

cues.text: The US government is already offering billions of dollars to try to get a direct air capture industry off the ground.
cues.en: The US government is already offering billions of dollars to try to get a direct air capture industry off the ground.
cues.zh: 美國政府已經提供數十億美元，試圖推動直接空氣捕獲產業的發展。

cues.text: And I think it makes sense for the countries that have used the most fossil fuels to do the work of finding out
cues.en: And I think it makes sense for the countries that have used the most fossil fuels to do the work of finding out
cues.zh: 我認為對於使用最多化石燃料的國家來說，進行找出答案的工作是有意義的

cues.text: if CDR can scale.
cues.en: if CDR can scale.
cues.zh: 如果 CDR 可以擴充。

cues.text: But if it doesn't...
cues.en: But if it doesn't...
cues.zh: 但如果不...

cues.text: well, then net zero will have been just another way of kicking the can down the road.
cues.en: well, then net zero will have been just another way of kicking the can down the road.
cues.zh: 好吧，那麼淨零排放就只是另一種方式。

cues.text: Which, of course, is how we ended up here in the first place.
cues.en: Which, of course, is how we ended up here in the first place.
cues.zh: 當然，這就是我們最初來到這裡的原因。

cues.text: In this position where we may now have no choice...
cues.en: In this position where we may now have no choice...
cues.zh: 在這種情況下，我們現在可能別無選擇......

cues.text: but to try everything.
cues.en: but to try everything.
cues.zh: 但要嘗試一切。
